  const masterPublished=await api.inject({method:'POST',url:`/api/documents/${edited.id}/commits`,payload:{baseVersion:22,mutationId:randomUUID(),commands:[{type:'element.patch',slideId:'master-editor',target:footerId,patch:{text:'Editable master'}},{type:'layout.publish',slideId:'master-editor'},{type:'slide.update',slideId:'copy-page',patch:{layoutId:'master'}}]}});assert.equal(masterPublished.statusCode,200,masterPublished.body);
  const masterPreview=await api.inject(`/api/documents/${edited.id}/preview`);const masterRendered=await content.inject(new URL(masterPreview.json().slides.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id==='copy-page').url).pathname);assert.equal(masterRendered.statusCode,200,masterRendered.body);assert.match(masterRendered.body,/Editable master/);
  const placeholderCommands:Command[]=[{type:'element.patch',slideId:'master-editor',target:footerId,patch:{attributes:{'data-notale-placeholder':'footer'}}},{type:'layout.publish',slideId:'master-editor'},{type:'layout.values',slideId:'copy-page',id:'master',values:{footer:'Page-specific teaching note'}}];
  const valuesSaved=await api.inject({method:'POST',url:`/api/documents/${edited.id}/commits`,payload:{baseVersion:23,mutationId:randomUUID(),commands:placeholderCommands}});assert.equal(valuesSaved.statusCode,200,valuesSaved.body);
  const valuesPage=valuesSaved.json().document.slides.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id==='copy-page');assert.equal(valuesPage.layoutValues.master.footer,'Page-specific teaching note');assert.equal(layoutPlaceholders(valuesSaved.json().document.layouts.find((l:{id:string})=>l.id==='master').html)[0].id,'footer');
  const valuesPreview=await api.inject(`/api/documents/${edited.id}/preview`);const valuesRendered=await content.inject(new URL(valuesPreview.json().slides.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id==='copy-page').url).pathname);assert.equal(valuesRendered.statusCode,200,valuesRendered.body);assert.match(valuesRendered.body,/Page-specific teaching note/);
  const pixelData='iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAwMCAO+jHn0AAAAASUVORK5CYII=';
  const imageUpload=await api.inject({method:'POST',url:'/api/assets',payload:{data:pixelData,mime:'image/png'}});assert.equal(imageUpload.statusCode,200,imageUpload.body);
  const imageCommands:Command[]=[{type:'asset.put',path:'media/packed-placeholder.png',asset:imageUpload.json()},{type:'element.insert',slideId:'master-editor',html:`<img data-notale-image-placeholder="photo" src="data:image/png;base64,${pixelData}" style="width:200px;height:100px;object-fit:cover">`},{type:'layout.publish',slideId:'master-editor'},{type:'layout.image',slideId:'copy-page',id:'master',key:'photo',image:{path:'media/packed-placeholder.png',alt:'Packed page illustration'}}];
  const imageSaved=await api.inject({method:'POST',url:`/api/documents/${edited.id}/commits`,payload:{baseVersion:24,mutationId:randomUUID(),commands:imageCommands}});assert.equal(imageSaved.statusCode,200,imageSaved.body);assert.equal(layoutImageSlots(imageSaved.json().document.layouts.find((l:{id:string})=>l.id==='master').html)[0].id,'photo');
  const imagePreview=await api.inject(`/api/documents/${edited.id}/preview`);const imageRendered=await content.inject(new URL(imagePreview.json().slides.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id==='copy-page').url).pathname);assert.equal(imageRendered.statusCode,200,imageRendered.body);assert.match(imageRendered.body,/packed-placeholder.png/);assert.match(imageRendered.body,/Packed page illustration/);
  const usedImageRemoval=await api.inject({method:'POST',url:`/api/documents/${edited.id}/commits`,payload:{baseVersion:25,mutationId:randomUUID(),commands:[{type:'asset.remove',path:'media/packed-placeholder.png'}]}});assert.equal(usedImageRemoval.statusCode,422,usedImageRemoval.body);
  const canvasPage=imageSaved.json().document.slides.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id==='canvas-source');
  const canvasRoot=Object.keys(inspectCanvasSources(canvasPage))[0];assert.ok(canvasRoot);
  const canvasCopy:Command={type:'elements.transfer',slideId:'copy-page',sourceSlideId:'canvas-source',targets:[canvasRoot],mode:'copy',offset:{x:0,y:0},rectangles:[],computedStyles:{},canvasSceneStates:{[canvasRoot]:{M:31,rho:0.75,eps:0.25,seed:876}}};
  const canvasSaved=await api.inject({method:'POST',url:`/api/documents/${edited.id}/commits`,payload:{baseVersion:25,mutationId:randomUUID(),commands:[canvasCopy]}});assert.equal(canvasSaved.statusCode,200,canvasSaved.body);
  const canvasDest=canvasSaved.json().document.slides.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id==='copy-page');const canvasId=Object.keys(canvasDest.canvasInstances)[0];const canvasInstance:CanvasInstance=canvasDest.canvasInstances[canvasId];assert.equal(canvasInstance.adapter,'correlation-v1');assert.equal(canvasDest.scenes.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id===canvasId).values.seed,876);
  const canvasEdited=await api.inject({method:'POST',url:`/api/documents/${edited.id}/commits`,payload:{baseVersion:26,mutationId:randomUUID(),commands:[{type:'scene.set',slideId:'copy-page',sceneId:canvasId,values:{M:15,seed:321}},{type:'slide.delete',slideId:'canvas-source'}]}});assert.equal(canvasEdited.statusCode,200,canvasEdited.body);
  const canvasPreview=await api.inject(`/api/documents/${edited.id}/preview`);const canvasRendered=await content.inject(new URL(canvasPreview.json().slides.find((s:{id:string})=>s.id==='copy-page').url).pathname);assert.equal(canvasRendered.statusCode,200,canvasRendered.body);assert.match(canvasRendered.body,/__NOTALE_CANVAS_FACTORIES__/);assert.match(canvasRendered.body,/function generateMatrix/);
  console.log('Packed package: strict TS consumer, typed independent Canvas transfer/defaults/source-page deletion/rendered factory, typed named-step duplication/reordering/notes/pacing and linked-instance schedule persistence through publication, shared library publication/instantiation/update, stable instance/state overrides and container sizing HTTP contracts, generic component/state/event/step HTTP contracts and original native adoption/appearance, typed interactive component transfer/state HTTP persistence and rendered controllers, independent native chart copy/source removal, typed full Canvas checkpoint HTTP persistence, typed private Canvas scene choice discovery/save, typed native ECharts patch HTTP save, native chart edit, SVG layer/connector HTTP editing, connected-page batches and owned-geometry rollback, affine/constrained text snapping, scoped HTTP create/anchored independent-axis scale/nullable text dimensions, stable preview renewal, rendered layout/bridge and static workbench all passed.');
}finally{
  for(const table of ['editor_mutations','editor_revision_assets','editor_revisions','editor_documents'])await pool.query(`DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE ${table==='editor_documents'?'id':'document_id'}=$1`,[edited.id]);
  await pool.query('DELETE FROM editor_uploads WHERE scope=$1',[context.scope]);
  await api.close();await content.close();await pool.end();
}
